description: AI insights, forecasts narration and market analysis. Server environment variables SERK_AI_PROVIDER, SERK_AI_MODEL, SERK_AI_API_KEY and SERK_AI_BASE_URL take precedence (same convention as SERK Finance). The AI only reads aggregated figures; it never posts, edits or deletes anything.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Stored encrypted. Not needed when SERK_AI_API_KEY is set on the server.

fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: Only for OpenAI-compatible or self-hosted endpoints. HTTPS required.

fields.label: Share Product Names With The Model
fields.description: Product and category names are sent with figures. Customer names, cashiers' emails and passwords are never sent.

fields.label: Market Context
fields.description: Optional facts about your market the AI should consider (city, competitors, seasonality, holidays). The AI has no live internet data.

name: SERK AI Settings
